A good listening setup starts with a few simple checks.
Why does the boost sound unchanged?

Play familiar audio and try Compare original, then Restore boost. Close other equalizers. Under Audio controls, try Player sessions and restart playback. Android target reports an effect setting; some players or outputs bypass it.
Why does boost stop in the background?

Enable Run in background and allow notifications. If your phone still stops it, review the app battery settings. Force stopping the app, restarting the phone or Android terminating the service ends boost. It will not restart by itself.

Lower extra boost first, and try Balanced EQ. Clipping and harsh sound can happen at high gain. The app cannot guarantee speaker or hearing protection. Stop if sound is uncomfortable; a dB boost setting is not a measured listening level.

Android 8.0 and newer phones and tablets can install Auralift. Actual boosting depends on the device, player and output. The Pixel 9a owner reported success with the previous preview; other combinations need testing. Calls and alarms are not supported targets.
What happens when an Ad Pass ends?

Gain above +15 dB drops to +15 dB. Lower gain and EQ stay as chosen. The theme returns to Mint and the floating player closes. Saved sounds stay stored. Earn another pass or buy Pro once to unlock again; this never raises the gain automatically. Reinstalling does not grant a pass.
Why does spectrum ask for microphone permission?

Android requires that permission for its playback Visualizer API. Auralift uses only low-resolution playback data for the display while Listen is visible. It does not open the microphone, save audio or send it anywhere. You can leave spectrum off.
